# dsh-generative-ui

Let the AI output **interactive HTML components** (Generative UI) directly in
the DSH chat flow.
The agent writes a fenced code block in its reply:

[代码示例省略，未执行]
generative-ui
<button id="plus">+1</button> 0

[代码示例省略，未执行]
`

The plugin extracts every artifact from that turn and renders it as a sandboxed
card below the messa

ge: an `<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts">` (no same-origin)
— the artifact is fully interactive, but

can never touch the host page,
cookies, or local storage.
## Design

- **Pure client-side: no backend, no storage.** Artifacts live in the session
message text — the ses

sion is the store; there is no second copy of state
and nothing to sync.
- The host half does one th

ing: broadcast the fenced-block convention to every
agent via `systemPrompt.section`.
- The browser

half uses a `uiConversation.events` accumulator to extract
artifacts from `assistant/message` events

(the same turn-accumulator pattern
as dsh-taskboard), projects them onto the turn location, and ren

ders the
cards through the `conversation.chat.turnTail` slot.
- Adaptive height: a bootstrap injecte

d into each artifact reports its height
to the parent via ResizeObserver + postMessage; cards are cl

amped between
120–600px and scroll internally beyond that.
## Layout constraints
An artifact is a bare iframe document: no font, no spacing reset, no surface. Every artifact documen
t therefore gets a design system inlined into `<head>` (`DESIGN_SYSTEM_CSS`), so constrained generat
ion is enforced at runtime rather than merely requested in the prompt:
- **Separate regions with surfaces, not borders.** `--gui-surface-1/2/3` is a three-step surface ram

p; `--gui-tint` / `--gui-tint-strong` are accent washes.
- **Three type sizes, no more.** `--gui-fs-
title`(18) / `--gui-fs-body`(14) / `--gui-fs-caption`(12); hierarchy comes from weight and `--gui-fg

-dim`, not from 1.08-ratio size steps.
- **Spacing and radius are tokens only.** `--gui-gap`(12) / `

--gui-pad`(16), radius `--gui-radius`(12) / `--gui-radius-sm`(8); chips stay fully round.
- **Outer
spacing is reset.** `html,body{margin:0!important;padding:0!important}` keeps artifacts flush with t

he message column; inner blocks own their spacing.
- **A typography baseline.** System font stack, 1

4px/1.7, an 11–17px size scale — no browser-default serif.
- **Utilities**: `.gui-stack` `.gui-secti
on` `.gui-section--tint` `.gui-card` `.gui-tint` `.gui-chip` `.gui-chip--on` `.gui-label` `.gui-titl

e` `.gui-desc` `.gui-note` `.gui-grid`.
- **Interaction and motion built in.** `button` ships with t
he primary style, `:active` scale, `:focus-visible` ring and 44px touch height; motion stays on `tra

nsform`/`opacity` under 200ms with `--gui-ease`, plus a `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback.
- **Audit
**: `auditArtifactSource(source)` reports violations (`border` / `shadow` / `gradient` / `blur` / `b
ody-spacing` / `comment` / `em-dash` / `buzzword` / `pure-color`) without blocking the render.
The same rules travel to the model as text in `GENERATIVE_UI_GUIDANCE`.
